force.limits: No candidate cap, work charge, or scalar-order reduction is claimed.

allocations.name: old coordinate Float64
allocations.lifetime: whole iteration; never overwrite while field or next routes read it

allocations.name: retained tangent Float64
allocations.lifetime: same initial atan2 result feeds field and gradient; avoids repeated tangent arithmetic

allocations.name: next coordinate Float64
allocations.lifetime: append complete per-edge output; atomic swap after all edges

allocations.name: field Float64 and presence Uint8
allocations.lifetime: same sample/channel/cell sum order; zero-valued inserted cells retain presence

allocations.name: old/new offset Uint32
allocations.lifetime: exact edge order, no narrowing past supported sample count

allocations.name: per-edge segment/weighted/advect/smooth/resample scratch
allocations.lifetime: conservative reusable scratch bound; exact layout must be proven before implementation

allocations.name: original endpoint coordinate snapshots
allocations.lifetime: original exact endpoints including signed zero through finalization

density.limits: No 20-iteration S/T sequence has been executed beyond default guard. The initial count is not substituted for later counts.
